fields.label: Profile Logo
fields.tooltip: Placed in the lower-left corner of the banner. Text-based logo is acceptable. Min 400px.

fields.label: Grid® Logo
fields.tooltip: Appears small in reports and awards. Do not include text — use icon/symbol only.

fields.label: What is [Product]?
fields.tooltip: Objective, dictionary-style definition. Opening sentence: '[Product] is a type of [software category] solution that helps users [use case].' Follow with 3-5 bullet points. No promotional language — avoid words like 'best', 'easiest', 'cutting-edge'.

subsections.label: Section 2: Profile Details > 2b. Additional Profile Detail Fields

fields.label: Languages Supported
fields.tooltip: List languages the software UI supports — not the support team's languages.

fields.label: CTA Button URL
fields.tooltip: Point to: free trial page, product landing page, or sales/demo contact form.

fields.label: UTM Parameters
fields.tooltip: Tracking parameters appended to product and vendor website URLs.

fields.label: Main Category
fields.tooltip: Determines breadcrumb navigation and is pre-selected on the review form. Choose the category that best represents the product.

fields.label: Additional Categories
fields.tooltip: Additional G2 categories for this product (up to 3). Category changes must meet G2's inclusion criteria.

fields.label: Product Page URL
fields.tooltip: Should point to the tricentis.com product page.

fields.label: Product Name
fields.tooltip: Check capitalisation and naming convention.

fields.label: Seller Domain
fields.tooltip: Consistent across all products.

fields.label: Year Founded
fields.tooltip: Consistent across all products.

fields.label: HQ Location
fields.tooltip: Consistent across all products.

fields.label: X (Twitter) Handle
fields.tooltip: Consistent across all products.

fields.label: Seller Description
fields.tooltip: Tricentis company boilerplate. Shared across all product listings.

fields.label: Pricing Package(s)
fields.tooltip: Each package contains pricing editions/levels with cost and feature details. Even if exact pricing cannot be disclosed, adding editions with feature details helps buyers understand which tier may fit their needs.

fields.label: Pricing Description
fields.tooltip: 70-150 words. Opening sentence: '[Product] pricing model is designed for [use case].' Include: overview of pricing tiers, any discounts/promotions, how pricing differs from competitors, how it caters to customer needs. Incorporate relevant keywords for SEO.

fields.label: Footer
fields.tooltip: Optional. Additional information, disclosures, legal disclaimers, or further pricing details. Appears below the pricing table.

fields.label: Free Trial Available?
fields.tooltip: Shown below the pricing table and on compare pages.

fields.label: Pricing List File
fields.tooltip: Upload a full pricing document if the pricing structure is too complex for the Basic Details fields alone.
